project_spherical — 3D lidar_projection op

• Data kinds: points → image2d

• Call: import spherical_proj; spherical_proj.project_spherical(points, h_res: 'int' = 1024, v_res: 'int' = 64, v_fov=(-25.0, 15.0)) -> 'np.ndarray' (or ops3d.get("project_spherical"))

Usage

Project into the spherical range image of a spinning LiDAR (v_res, h_res). Empty cells are 0; nearer points win (minimum range).
